node.title: Re^3: Mocking LDAP in your tests
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
how exactly do you use Net::LDAP to search through LDIF files?

The documentation of [mod://Net::LDAP::LDIF] shows an example of how to read an LDIF file. If you're having trouble, it'd be best if you posted a new question (at the bottom of [id://479]), and follow the advice in [id://174051] and [id://1177642].
